apps.name: Cercube for YouTube
apps.subtitle: Offline, PiP, background play and no ads for YouTube
apps.localizedDescription: Cercube for YouTube is the official YouTube enhancement from the original Cercube developer, relaunched in 2026: cache media for offline playback, use Picture in Picture and background playback, block supported video, feed and Shorts ads, choose default playback quality separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, reorder or hide tabs, auto-replay, skip sponsored segments, show dislike counts, queue videos - in 14 languages. It hooks the App Store YouTube app. Official distribution: apt.cercube.com (rootful, rootless and roothide jailbreak) and the altstore.cercube.com sideload source for AltStore (Classic), SideStore, Feather, eSign and friends.
apps.versionDescription:
Cercube for YouTube 6.1.3 - the current official release (verified against apt.cercube.com on 2026-09-18).

This release improves caching, ad blocking, and compatibility with older iOS versions.
- Added compatibility for iOS 15-16
- Minor bug fixes and improvements

Previously: 6.1.2 added dislike counts, sponsored segment skipping and 14 languages; 6.0.1 added compatibility for recent iOS versions.

compatibility.notes: Official package com.cercube.ios v6.1.3 from the developer's own repository (apt.cercube.com, SHA256-published). The direct link below is the official arm64 .deb - install it with TrollStore or on a jailbroken device. Without a jailbreak, add the official source https://altstore.cercube.com to AltStore (Classic), SideStore or Feather instead; it injects Cercube into the App Store YouTube app. The sideloaded home-screen icon is the YouTube icon (this entry reuses it); the tweak's own branding icon is published at https://cdn.cercube.com/assets/icon.png.
